screen_derivation.method_origin: Inclusive melting-interval overlap with hotspot local-day air maxima and premonsoon surface-temperature percentile.
screen_derivation.upper_equation: round(percentile(valid Delhi pre-monsoon common-grid LST_C, 95, linear), 1)
screen_derivation.pass_equation: Tm_high_C >= lower_C AND Tm_low_C <= upper_C; PCM_RUNNABLE only
screen_derivation.purpose: thermal relevance only; annual activation/saturation/utilisation/regeneration belong to Category 1

daily_air.window_basis: local calendar dates; [local midnight start, local midnight stop)
daily_air.hourly_sample_semantics: instantaneous canonical midpoint; exact acquired UTC source hour; no interpolation
daily_air.missing_policy: fail on missing/duplicate/extra hours or days; no interpolation/substitution
daily_air.statistic: mean of complete local daily Tmax from hourly hotspot T_air_C

hotspot_location.location_method: selected cell center nearest built-fraction-weighted hotspot centroid; row-major tie
hotspot_location.weather_resolution_note: 150 m grid locates hotspot only; weather remains one coarse native ERA5-Land cell.

spatial_support.extraction_method: Image.sample at hotspot point; exact native projection; no scale/factor/numPixels; dropNulls=False
spatial_support.pixel_coordinate_convention: EE pixelCoordinates continuous center=(col+0.5,row+0.5); integer containing-cell indices=floor(coordinates).
spatial_support.projection_validation: Every source hour and required band: semantic CRS + six numeric affine coefficients; fixed integer pixel and center containing hotspot point.
spatial_support.support_limitation: Single coarse regional reanalysis cell at hotspot location; no 150 m meteorological resolution.

screen_derivation.candidate_order: original verified workbook order; no ranking
screen_derivation.limitations: coarse hotspot hourly-sampled local daily air maxima plus Delhi overpass composite LST roof proxy; not measured roof bounds or a regeneration result
